Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing spas, wedding boutiques, and art galleries to serve wine or beer to their customers who are twentyone years of age or older.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing spas, wedding boutiques, and artgalleries to serve wine or beer to their customers who are twentyoneyears of age or older; adding new sections to chapter 66.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Nothing in this title applies to or prevents a spa, weddingboutique, or art gallery from offering or supplying without charge wineor beer by the individual glass to a customer for consumption on thepremises. However, the customer must be at least twentyone years ofage and may only be offered one glass of wine or beer, and the wine orbeer must have been legally purchased under this title. If the wine orbeer is offered by a spa that provides massages, the wine or beer maynot be offered to the customer until the massage is completed. (2) For the purposes of this section: (a) "Art gallery" means a room or building devoted to theexhibition and/or sale of the works of art. (b) "Spa" means a business that offers beauty services including, p. 1 SSB 5110but not limited to, shampooing, cutting, styling, or dyeing hair,manicures, pedicures, facials, massages, and the use of body toningequipment. (c) "Wedding boutique" means a business that specializes in thesale of wedding merchandise.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The board may adopt rules to implement section 1 of this act.
